paragraphs: Crown Prince Franz falls in love with Sylvia, a young woman working in a Belgian laundry, but Sylvia believes their difference in rank makes marriage impossible. grh_bf1efc72859fb1999b10.title: Uncle Zora Comes to the Pig Festival
paragraphs: A Nebraska town's annual pig festival becomes the stage for a comic battle with Carrie Woodruff, a domineering gossip whose accusations threaten widow Dorothy Griffith and the young people around her. Dorothy's colorful visiting Uncle Zora Miller joins the effort to distract, expose, and finally stand up to Carrie as family secrets and romantic misunderstandings spill into public. When Melinda Jane's planned marriage to Freddie Baker is revealed, the town closes ranks against Carrie's meddling and forces her to apologize publicly to Dorothy, her daughter, and Zora.
